name: SportQory Sports Support Fund
note: Kazakh state-linked sports support fund: sole operator for extra-budgetary sport funding, overseen by the Ministry of Culture and Sport, funded mainly by Samruk-Kazyna, and manager of the XDS Astana Team since 2024. Its logo sits on the back of the 2026 jersey. Claims added 2026-10-01; tier proposal (concern) in pull request — a maintainer sets tiers.
